description: Adds prepaid USDC credit to a manager the executor runs; each sent operation is charged from it (gas × 1.5, at least the chain's minimum). Without payment the result is an error whose structuredContent is the x402 PaymentRequired: an x402 MCP client retries with _meta["x402/payment"]; any other client POSTs to `payUrl` and pays its HTTP 402. Anyone may pay; the credit only ever pays for this manager's operations and is not refunded.

amountUsdc.description: USDC to add (2–200 by default; executor_terms)

name: executor_topup
title: Cloud executor: add credit (paid, x402)
